patch_description:
Crossover of the two highest-scoring seeds. From the 0.72-scoring seed we keep the fully-shared RY pre-rotation layer (single "ry_a" parameter across all 8 qubits) and the enriched entangling topology (nearest-neighbor ring + opposite-qubit long-range links + skip-2 shell, all Ising ZZ couplers). From the 0.71-scoring seed we keep the sandwich structure of global RZ phase layers around the entangling block and the forward/backward CNOT ladders that provide extra zero-parameter mixing.

The key new idea driving this crossover is parameter unification across gate types: both the RZ phase layers and all ZZ couplers reuse the SAME trainable parameter name ("theta"), which is allowed since parameter sharing is defined purely by string identity, not gate type. This collapses the previous 3-distinct-parameter design (ry_a, rz_p, zz_ring) down to just 2 distinct parameters (ry_a, theta) while preserving the full expressive gate structure (same depth/gate-count as the strongest seed). Since the scoring rule states parameter economy always dominates with no diminishing returns, cutting from 3 to 2 distinct parameters should directly improve the score, provided the rich connectivity (ring + long-range + skip-2, sandwiched with RZ phase layers and bidirectional CNOT ladders) preserves the robust separation and worst-group margin observed in the top-performing seeds.
